description: The Celtic Cross tarot spread explained: its ten cards, the cross and the staff, how the two halves work and when this spread suits a question.
lede: The Celtic Cross is a ten-card tarot spread that looks at one situation from many sides. Here is how the cross and the staff fit together.

layout.alt: The ten-card Celtic Cross tarot layout. A cross of six cards on the left: 1 in the centre, 2 laid across it, 3 below, 4 to the left, 5 above and 6 to the right. A vertical staff of four cards beside it, from the bottom: 7, 8, 9 and 10. A list on the right names the positions: 1 Heart of the matter, 2 Crossing, 3 Foundation, 4 Recent past, 5 Crown, 6 Near future, 7 You, 8 Surroundings, 9 Hopes and fears, 10 Outcome.
layout.caption: A cross of six cards describes the situation. A staff of four cards shows you, your surroundings and where it may head.
